name: Payment Services Directive 3 and Payment Services Regulation
description: Proposed (2023) successor to PSD2; split into a Directive (PSD3, on licensing) and a Regulation (PSR, on conduct rules). Strengthens SCA, expands open finance scope, addresses payment fraud, and introduces VOP (Verification of Payee) requirements.
